Metabolomics association dashboard

Synthetic demonstration study · 120 samples · 384 curated features · 3 outcomes

Synthetic data. Every number on this page comes from a seeded simulation in omicsdash.simulate. No real study, subject or measurement is represented here, and none is needed to reproduce it.

1 · Data curation

Features are kept when they are detected in at least 70% of study samples and vary by no more than 30% RSD across the pooled QC injections. Remaining gaps are filled at half the feature minimum, then the table is log2-transformed and median-centred per sample.

2 · Feature set and annotation levels

Annotation level records how confidently a feature is identified. Most untargeted features stay unknown, which is expected and is the reason association results are reported at feature level rather than as named metabolites.

Annotation levelFeaturesShare
Level 1 — Confirmed against a standard236.0%

3 · Principal component analysis

An unsupervised check on what dominates the curated table. Batch separation along an early component is a sign that acquisition, not biology, is the largest source of variance.

4 · Daily step count

One linear model per feature: feature ~ activity_steps + age + sex + bmi, with Benjamini-Hochberg control across the 384 curated features. Estimates read as log2 abundance change per standard deviation of the outcome.
